purpose: Record successful collection mutations in deterministic sequence order.

description.text: Synthetic deterministic audit child; no storage or external logging.

copies.statement: Audit events and their items are detached copies; history is per instance and starts empty.

sequence.statement: Successful state changes append exactly one event with consecutive sequence numbers starting at one.

successful.statement: Record successful add, first completion and removal; rejected operations and repeated completion append no event.

mutations.statement: Observe add, complete and remove state changes.

events.statement: audit() returns events containing exactly sequence, operation and a detached item.

excluded.statement: Reads, rejected operations and already-complete no-ops leave audit history unchanged.
